messages:
Sana: heads up — saving a small routing change in Console triggered a lint error I didn't expect. thought it was my YAML but reproducing in a pared-down route.
Sana: here's the snippet I'm saving:
```yaml
routes:
  - id: /api/predict
    match:
      path: /predict
      headers:
        - name: X-User
          exact: \"redwood\"
    overrides:
      headers:
        X-User: \"{{request.user.id}}\"
```
Sana: lint message says: `invalid header override format: got array vs map` — but match.headers is an array and overrides.headers is intentionally a map. should be allowed, right? :thinking:
LintBot: R-HEADER-OVRD: found mismatch between `match.headers` (array) and `overrides.headers` (map). Rule currently enforces both to be lists or both maps for consistency. (docs: routing-lint/v0.9)
Kevin: hmm, afaict schema defines `match.headers` as list<object> and `overrides.headers` as map<string,string>. they intentionally differ. Linter rule might be too strict.
Jin: yup — schema intentionally models match as list so matchers can include `exact`, `prefix`, etc. overrides is a map for convenience. the linter assumed both were same shape for simple validation but that's wrong.
Sana: the Console editor is trying to show a live preview and apparently converts the map into a list for preview, then the linter runs against that preview object and errors.
Kevin: so bug is in the Console preview normalization + linter combo. two options: (A) change linter to accept the canonical schema difference, or (B) change preview to keep canonical shapes. A seems lower risk short term.
Jin: Agreed. quick list:
- relax R-HEADER-OVRD to accept `map` overrides when `match.headers` is an array.
- linter should also allow templated values (mustache like `{{...}}`) in overrides — currently it's flagged as non-literal.
- add unit test that covers array->map case and templated values.
Sana: I can paste the failing unit test output from routing-lint-tests:
```
FAILED tests/test_header_override.py::test_array_match_map_override
E   AssertionError: LintViolation(R-HEADER-OVRD) raised unexpectedly
```
Sana: Console UX note: when we warn, show a hint: "Overrides are a map by design — we accept templated values. Convert to list only for matchers." small tooltip might avoid confusion.
Kevin: for the linter change, also add an auto-fix suggestion: if user intentionally used list in overrides, suggest converting map -> list of `{name: X, value: Y}` entries. but don't autofix templated values.
Jin: I'll open a PR to routing-lint to implement the rule relaxation + unit tests. will also add a regression test in console-preview that ensures preview object shapes match schema before linting.
Sana: thanks. can we also add a short dev-doc blurb in the console editor code pointing to the schema differences? I spent ~20m debugging without realizing shapes differ.
Kevin: yes please — add a small section in /docs/dev/console-preview.md and link it from the lint rule comment.
LintBot: created issue RL-423: "Console preview normalizes overrides to list causing R-HEADER-OVRD false positive" — assigned to Jin, estimate 1d. test: https://redwood/infra/rl/423 (internal)
Sana: perfect. Jin lmk if you want me to pair on the test.
Jin: will do — thanks :+1:
Kevin: once PR lands, I'll queue a small patch in Console to skip lint until we run the new linter (short rollout). :thumbsup:
Sana: resolved for now — leaving thread open until PR merged.
